prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original 3D-game-asset reference of a modest inhabited timber log house in a snowy Tatar village, for URMAN. Input image 1 is our exact current Variant A house, front-right view; image 2 is its front elevation. They define the plan, envelope and openings ONLY. Input image 3 is our owner-approved game scene: use the central dark timber house ONLY as the material/rendering family (tactile believable weathered wood, restrained carved casings, snow, soft real-time winter light). Do not import its front door or change the Variant A plan.
Preserve a main gabled body approximately 6.0m wide x5.8m deep, eave2.85m, ridge4.55m, modest30cm foundation, roof overhang36cm. The main street-facing gable has EXACTLY THREE evenly spaced tall narrow windows, NO DOOR. Window clear sizes about0.96x1.45m, sill0.93m, heads2.38m, centers at-1.74/0/+1.74m. Keep the modest enclosed lean-to vestibule on the RIGHT SIDE toward the REAR, as in image1: its entry door is set back in that small side vestibule and FACES FORWARD parallel to the main front, not on the main facade and not on the outer right wall. Keep a clear0.94x2.02m doorway with a step, and one window on the vestibule's outer right wall. Keep the main right-wall window ahead of the vestibule.
Replace the plain flat wall panels with a CONSTRUCTIVELY CREDIBLE srub: continuous level horizontal log courses of consistent~23cm pitch actually resting on the course below. Use ONE coherent saddle-notched projecting-end corner system, with perpendicular wall logs interlocking in alternate courses, short readable round log ends at both front corners. No vertical corner posts covering incorrect joints. Cut complete rectangular window openings into the courses; use proper jambs, seated sills and supported headers, and two intact bearing courses above the windows. No logs floating across glass, hanging cut ends, diagonal random logs or loose stacked sticks. Roof rafters and wall plates visibly bear on the walls; real fascias, closed eaves and plausible chimney/roof contact. Small plain boarded upper gable as in the existing house. No fantasy carvings.
Weathered grey-brown rounded/hewn logs, subtle end grain, restrained faded blue-green and off-white wooden window casings in the family of the approved house, deep readable glass recesses and sills. Muted aged metal gabled roof with settled snow on upper surfaces and clean thin eaves; one restrained chimney as in the actual existing asset. The vestibule is subordinate weathered boarding with a lower lean-to roof. Keep an ordinary inhabited house, not a monumental cabin, medieval hut or luxury chalet. A clean straight shallow rectangular foundation, no organic Meshy pedestal or root-like base.
Show the COMPLETE single house, all roof edges, side vestibule and foundation, centered, front-right three-quarter view with the three front windows and side entry visible, enough surrounding margin. Neutral light grey empty studio background and even neutral daylight; no terrain slab, yard props, fence, trees, people, text or watermark. Material-rich real-time 3D appearance matching the approved house; avoid toy-like flat panels, hyperphotographic grunge and excessive ornamental noise. This is a reference for later3D generation, so all construction and openings must be unambiguous.
